events.summary: Arizona's Medicaid agency announces payment suspensions on credible allegations of fraud from May 16, 2023, tied to investigations into fraudulent Medicaid billing by the named providers.

scope.note: The quote names no service or billing code. Elsewhere the same fact sheet speaks of sober living homes and behavioral health services. Codes beginning with H stand in for behavioral health.

source.publisher: Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS)
source.title: Fact Sheet: AHCCCS Provider Payment Suspensions, updated May 2024
source.quote: The Credible Allegation of Fraud (CAF) payment suspensions announced since May 16, 2023 are associated with wide-ranging investigations into fraudulent Medicaid billing by the named providers.
